categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the optical communication industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance optical modules. Its product portfolio includes a wide range of optical modules such as 100G, 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T modules, serving applications in AI/ML clusters, cloud data centers, data communications, 5G wireless networks, telecom transmission, and fixed network access.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including VCSEL/EML, silicon photonics, thin-film lithium niobate, coherent optical modules, and LPO technology. It employs order-based production managed via an ERP system to optimize material usage and control costs. The company also emphasizes vertical integration covering optical chip manufacturing, chip packaging, optical device packaging, and optical module manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global mainstream internet companies and communication equipment manufacturers. The company serves domestic and international markets, focusing on data centers, AI/ML clusters, 5G front-haul, mid-haul, backhaul networks, metropolitan area networks, backbone networks, and core networks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the USA, Singapore, and Thailand. Its sales are predominantly international, accounting for approximately 83.75% of revenue, with domestic sales making up about 16.25%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned midstream to downstream in the optical communication supply chain, focusing on optical module manufacturing and packaging. It procures upstream components such as optical chips and integrated circuits from suppliers but performs key packaging and module assembly in-house, aiming for vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-speed optical modules (up to 1.6T), silicon photonics, coherent optical modules, and low-power optical (LPO) modules. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on product performance, stability, and customization to meet evolving market demands, especially for AI data centers and 5G networks. It also emphasizes talent development and digital transformation to enhance innovation and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical modules and components to communication equipment manufacturers, internet companies, and distributors. The company uses a combination of direct sales and buyout sales through distributors, recognizing revenue upon delivery and acceptance by customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few domestic enterprises capable of mass-producing 100G to 800G high-speed optical modules and holds a strong market position with advanced packaging technologies. It competes globally with major optical module manufacturers and aims to strengthen its core competitiveness through continuous innovation and vertical integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.1 billion, a 6.43% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 688 million, down 23.82%. Total assets reached RMB 6.44 billion, with equity of RMB 5.47 billion, reflecting steady growth and ongoing investment in production capacity expansion, including a new factory in Thailand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-speed, low-power, and cost-effective optical modules with diverse product types and broad application coverage. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced packaging technologies, flexible production lines, strong R&D capabilities, and the ability to meet customized customer requirements, particularly for emerging AI and 5G data center applications.
